text: On-call for data engineers — picking severity tiers back up, and finally attaching a name to each one.
Sev one pages the on-call engineer immediately, any hour. Sev two waits for business hours. Sev three just gets logged. Without a defined rotation, page someone fails exactly when it matters most.
A rotation with one person, indefinitely, eventually fails completely — not gradually, but exactly during the real sev one that needed a fresh, alert engineer.

The moment one shift ends and another begins, context can silently disappear. A short, deliberate handoff — what's unresolved, what to watch — is cheap insurance against the next person starting blind.
A real rotation, a real escalation path, a real handoff. Next up: a production incident, start to finish — every piece of this chapter, in motion.
